## About

Suraj Van Verma is a software engineer specializing in backend systems, machine learning, and AI/LLM tooling. He runs the bythebug brand — a YouTube channel, Instagram, and Spotify presence focused on software engineering and building in public.

Skills: Python, Go, distributed systems, LLM infrastructure, ML pipelines, Redis, Kafka, AWS, iOS development.

Contact: https://calendly.com/bythebug | https://github.com/bythebug

---

## Blog Posts

### The Wave We're Standing In: Notes on AI in September 2026
URL: https://bythebug.github.io/blog/the-wave-we-are-standing-in/
Date: 2026-09-18

A narrative essay on where AI actually stands in September 2026: the dense cadence of frontier model releases (Claude Fable 5.1, Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-6 Astra), the unresolved AGI timeline debate between lab leaders and independent forecasters, the "world models" turn led by Yann LeCun and Fei-Fei Li, the trust gap in enterprise agent adoption, the shift from GPU scarcity to power-grid scarcity as AI's real bottleneck, humanoid robots moving from demos to paid factory work, and the industry's late pivot toward binding AI regulation. Woven through with quotes from Nick Bostrom's *Superintelligence*, Mustafa Suleyman's *The Coming Wave*, and Max Tegmark's *Life 3.0*.

---

## Projects

### AI / ML
- **LLM Studio** (https://github.com/bythebug/llm-studio): Full-stack platform for fine-tuning LLMs with a job queue, remote GPU dispatch, and experiment tracking.
- **ML Forge** (https://github.com/bythebug/ml-forge): Feature engineering pipeline with 12 transformation techniques across 5 ML models.
- **Smart Suggest** (https://github.com/bythebug/smart-suggest): Recommendation engine with a built-in A/B testing framework and KPI tracking.
- **Market Graph** (https://github.com/bythebug/StockNet-Network-Based-Portfolio-Analyzer): Models the S&P 500 as a network graph using PageRank to identify market-driving stocks vs. followers.
- **Data Lens** (https://github.com/bythebug/data-lens): Self-serve analytics platform with full-text search, filtering, aggregation, and time-series queries over a REST API.
- **Vani AI** (https://github.com/bythebug/Vani-AI): LLM chatbot infrastructure for WhatsApp — multi-model routing over a single messaging layer.
- **Salary Prediction** (https://github.com/bythebug/Salary-Prediction-Web-App): ML-powered salary predictor with interactive visualizations. 90% accuracy, deployed on AWS.
- **AI Image Detector** (https://aiimagedetector.netlify.app/): Detects AI-generated images by reading embedded content provenance metadata — fully browser-side.

### Apps & Tools
- **iDoList** (https://github.com/bythebug/idolist): Life-management app to organize goals, tasks, and habits into one executable dashboard.
- **UML Canvas** (https://github.com/bythebug/lld-viz): Type Python, get a live UML class diagram. Zero setup, runs entirely in the browser.
- **Claude Monitor** (https://github.com/bythebug/claude-monitor): macOS menu bar app showing Claude Code usage percentage and session reset time.
- **LeetCode Streak Widget** (https://github.com/bythebug/LeetCode-Streak-Widget): Native macOS widget showing a 7x7 LeetCode submission calendar.
- **PicSort** (https://github.com/bythebug/PicSort-iOS-App): iOS gallery cleaner — swipe right to keep, left to delete.
- **MetroPass** (https://github.com/bythebug/MetroPass-Travel-Card-App): Contactless transit payments with RSA-encrypted card data. Keys never leave the device.
- **LeadScrape** (https://github.com/bythebug/scrappy): Automatically extracts email addresses from LinkedIn post comments.

### Backend / Infrastructure
- **Task Flow** (https://github.com/bythebug/task-flow): Task management API with role-based permissions, JWT auth, and Redis-backed queuing.
- **PubSub Hub** (https://github.com/bythebug/realtime-hub): Redis pub/sub fan-out with circuit breakers that isolate slow consumers without stalling upstream producers.
- **Distributed Log Processor** (https://github.com/bythebug/Real-Time-Distributed-Log-Processing-System): Processes 500K+ events/second — Kafka ingest with consumer groups and Redis-based deduplication.
- **URLtrim** (https://github.com/bythebug/urltrim): Personal URL shortener with custom aliases, click analytics, and built-in rate limiting.
